what: The scene score of each cut in tests/integration/shots.int.test.ts's clip, on the rgb24 path (docs/CLIPS.md §4.2, §4.9). The clip is made from `sources`: 640x360, 30 fps, two seconds each, lossless H.264 (-qp 0, yuv420p). On rgb24 a uniform change of dA in every channel scores |dA|/100; the two grey cuts do not saturate, so they are what tells the RGB formula from the Mac's Y-only one (0.34 and 0.17 there). Measured 2026-10-13 on the Mac's bundled ffmpeg (4.4); the 2018 Windows build must give the same within `tolerance`.
